subject: Novara Health: short-log carveout & 0-retention requirements - post-call recap
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@novarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: Novara Health discovery — data handling recap & next steps

Hi Julia,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the clear framing on your privacy constraints. Quick recap from my side so we have alignment and a proposed path forward: 

- Requirements you emphasized: 1) No persistent storage of PII-containing prompts/outputs (0-retention for PII); 2) Ability to retain limited non-PII telemetry (short-term logs) for debugging up to 7 days; 3) Data residency in us-east-1 for the pilot; 4) Audit evidence for retention windows and access logs for SOC2 review.
- Questions we raised: whether you can tolerate a short-lived KV cache for session continuity (7 days max) if PII is redacted at application edge; and whether the procurement/legal team will accept a limited pilot amendment rather than full MSA redlines up-front.

Recommended next steps: 
1) We will propose a short-log pilot config that enforces zero retention for identified PII and a 7-day TTL for non-PII telemetry. Marissa will attach a config sketch and a short-runbook for the pilot.
2) You to confirm the SCM redaction approach — if Novara can route PII through your redaction proxy before it hits the API, we can operate with 0-retention for PII without losing user experience. If not, we will propose an inline redaction supplement.
3) Procurement to indicate whether a pilot amendment (60-day pilot addendum) is acceptable; if so, we will prepare a draft and pricing for the pilot.

I attached the security questionnaire you emailed earlier and noted the relevant items we flagged.

If that aligns, we can schedule the pilot kickoff next week (Mon/Tue) and loop in engineering for a 30 minute onboarding call.

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: novara-security-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 42 pages)

From: Julia Park <julia.park@novarahealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matthew Lewis <matthew.lewis@novarahealth.com>, procurement@novarahealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 19:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Novara Health discovery — data handling recap & next steps

Diego — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few points from our side: 

- 0-retention for PII is a hard requirement for patient-identifiable content. We can redact at the application layer — our platform already redacts SSNs, MRNs, and explicit name identifiers before sending to vendors.
- We are comfortable with a short-term (<=7 day) window for non-PII telemetry strictly for debugging (request IDs, token counts, non-PII metadata). That telemetry must be pseudonymized and not include raw prompts with PHI.
- Data residency: pilot must run in us-east-1 and logs must be stored in our customer-dedicated bucket with RBAC limiting access to Novara and Redwood SOC contacts.
- For SOC2 evidence, we need an accessible audit log (read-only export) showing retention TTL enforcement and access events for the pilot period.

Procurement: we prefer a 60-day pilot amendment rather than a full MSA change initially. Please send a draft and estimated pilot pricing. We will review redlines and aim to return within 3 business days.

I attached the filled security questionnaire — the highlighted pages indicate items requiring further evidence.

Best,
Julia
Director of Privacy & Security, Novara Health

Attachment: novara-security-questionnaire.pdf (updated fillable)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@novarahealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed pilot config: short-log carveout + 0-retention for PII

Julia, Diego — following up with the technical approach we discussed. High-level: enforce per-customer retention policies at the routing layer with deterministic redaction and a separate telemetry pipeline for non-PII logs. Key elements attached in the YAML config and summarized below.

Summary of proposed controls (pilot):
- Ingress redaction hook: optional webhook to accept Novara’s redaction verdict. If app-edge redaction is used (preferred), Redwood will treat payloads flagged as "PII" as ephemeral and never persist beyond KV cache scope.
- Storage policies: persistent storage disabled for messages marked PII; ephemeral KV cache with 7-day TTL for non-PII session context (encrypted at rest, per-customer KMS key).
- Auditability: automated retention-enforcement events emitted to an append-only audit stream (read-only export to Novara S3 bucket daily).
- Access controls: RBAC + JIT approvals for any unlock; we will provide an audit bundle (S3 presigned) at the end of each pilot day.

Pilot deliverables: config (attached), runbook, acceptance checklist, and a small script to validate TTL enforcement. Suggested pilot timeline: 60 days with a 1-week onboarding + 6 weeks of data collection.

Next steps from our side: attach shortlog-pilot-config.yaml and a draft pilot amendment for procurement to review. Pricing estimate: $6,500/month for reserved pilot throughput (reflects dedicated routing + audit retention exports). Full commercial proposal to be finalized once procurement confirms amendment approach.

Let me know if you want a quick walkthrough — happy to demo the enforcement logs and audit bundle generation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: shortlog-pilot-config.yaml (text), novara-pilot-amendment-draft.docx

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligns with our expectations. Two quick asks before procurement signs the amendment: 
1) Please include a short excerpt in the amendment that states Redwood will not persist PII (defined in appendix A) beyond ephemeral cache and that any failure-to-redact incident triggers a notification and remediation SLA.
2) We need a sample audit export for retention enforcement (sanitized example) to attach to our SOC2 evidence pack.

Procurement: we can approve the 60-day pilot addendum; please move forward with the draft DocuSign and pricing as noted. We will aim to return redlines within 3 business days.
